title.en: Castor, Polydeuces, and the Cattle of Idas
title.zh: 卡斯托與波呂丟刻斯：伊達斯之牛

texts.period: Composed c. 7th-6th century BCE (Cypria; Nagy translation)

source.archive: Center for Hellenic Studies (Gregory Nagy, trans.)
source.work: Epic Cycle, Cypria, Proclus summary (trans. Gregory Nagy)

texts.license: Public domain (Proclus summary in Nagy translation)

summary.en: In the meantime, Kastor and Polydeukes are caught stealing the cattle of Idas and Lynkeus. Kastor is killed by Idas, but Idas and Lynkeus are killed by Polydeukes. And Zeus gives them both immortality on alternate days. Iris goes and tells Menelaos what has been happening at home. He returns and plans an expedition against Ilion with his brother.
summary.zh: 其間，卡斯托與波呂丟刻斯偷伊達斯與林叩斯之牛被發現。卡斯托為伊達斯所殺，伊達斯與林叩斯又為波呂丟刻斯所誅。宙斯遂賜二兄弟「隔日輪流」之永生。伊里斯將家中之事報與墨涅拉俄斯；他回國後與兄共謀遠征伊利翁。

title.en: Zeus and Themis Plan the Trojan War
title.zh: 宙斯與忒彌斯謀劃特洛伊戰爭

texts.period: Composed c. 7th-6th century BCE (Cypria; Nagy translation)

source.archive: Center for Hellenic Studies (Gregory Nagy, trans.)
source.work: Epic Cycle, Cypria, Proclus summary (trans. Gregory Nagy)

texts.license: Public domain (Proclus summary in Nagy translation)

summary.en: Zeus, together with Themis, plans the Trojan War. For Eris, while attending a feast of the gods at the wedding of Peleus, instigates a feud among Athena, Hera, and Aphrodite about beauty. They, by order of Zeus, are led by Hermes to Mount Ida for judgment by Alexandros. Alexandros judges for Aphrodite, encouraged by a promise of Helen in marriage. On the advice of Aphrodite, he has ships built; Helenos prophesies to him about what is going to happen; Aphrodite tells Aineias to sail with him; then Kassandra foretells the events of the future. When he gets to Lacedaemonia, Alexandros is entertained as a xenos by the sons of Tyndaros, and afterwards by Menelaos at Sparta; Alexandros gives Helen gifts during the feast. Menelaos sails off to Crete, telling Helen to provide proper hospitality for their xenoi while he is away; Aphrodite brings Helen and Alexandros together; and after their intercourse they load up a great many valuables and sail away by night.
summary.zh: 宙斯與忒彌斯共謀特洛伊戰爭。厄里斯（不和女神）赴珀琉斯婚宴，挑起雅典娜、赫拉、阿芙洛狄忒三女神之美貌之爭。宙斯命赫爾墨斯引三女神上伊達山，交由亞歷山德羅斯（帕里斯）評判；帕里斯因海倫之諾而判阿芙洛狄忒。他依阿芙洛狄忒之議造船；赫勒諾斯為他預言未來；阿芙洛狄忒命埃涅阿斯同行；卡珊德拉預言一切。帕里斯至斯巴達，受廷達瑞俄斯諸子與墨涅拉俄斯款待，宴中贈海倫禮物；墨涅拉俄斯赴克里特、囑海倫善待賓客；阿芙洛狄忒使二人結合，二人攜重寶夜遁。

Aphrodite brings Helen and Alexandros together; and after their intercourse they load up a great many valuables and sail away by night. Hera sends a storm down upon them; landing at Sidon, Alexandros captures the city. They sail to Ilion; Alexandros marries Helen.
